_comment: Copy to ~/.config/qwen-omarchy-control/browser.json (0600). Controls typed browser control (browser_read/click/type/navigate/search) via cua-driver's CDP binding. On by default; self-degrades to a clear message when no debug-enabled browser is present. Two prerequisites: Chrome must run with --remote-debugging-port (see bin/qwen-browser-debug.sh --enable) and cua-driver serve must have been started with --grant existing-profile.
